cluster_recommendation: Two real, distinct problems, neither solved by merging skills. (1) CLI rot across the orchestration cluster (swarm-advanced, hive-mind-advanced, stream-chain, performance-analysis): every `npx claude-flow ...` example risks resolving a different, older ruflo build than the pinned PATH binary (verified: npx → v3.5.75 vs pinned → v3.38.21), and several exact command names no longer exist in the deployed CLI — stream-chain's entire top-level command (and its only script) is dead, performance-analysis has 6 of 7 cited CLI invocations and 2 relative doc links broken, hive-mind-advanced cites a non-existent `hive-mind metrics` subcommand. The skills themselves are not duplicative — each owns a distinct, correctly cross-referenced niche (topology-swarm vs consensus-hive vs sequential-pipeline vs profiling) — so the fix is a CLI-example re-verification sweep against `claude-flow <cmd> --help`, not consolidation. (2) The agentdb-* family genuinely contradicts the estate memory doctrine, confirmed rather than assumed: agentdb-advanced and agentdb-memory-patterns instruct local AgentDB SQLite/QUIC workflows with zero mention that mcp__claude-flow__memory_* → RuVector-postgres (bge-small-en-v1.5) is this deployment's actual agent-memory path, and agentdb-vector-search's own "OpenAI API key" prerequisite line is the sharpest instance — worse, the correct distinction already exists (KHIVE-LEARNINGS.md correctly cites bge-small-en-v1.5) but is buried, never surfacing in the top-level SKILL.md. Recommend one shared banner in docs/agentdb-overview.md rather than collapsing the three skills or merging into ruvector-catalog — their content (RL/QUIC vs session memory vs HNSW/RAG tuning) is legitimately non-overlapping, well cross-referenced, and agentdb-learning's deprecation stub is healthy as-is. Separately: payment-router and cost-estimation were suspected dead/orphaned by their cross-reference isolation, but both are real, wired, gated subsystems (agentbox.toml gate, management-api routes, PRD-015, config validator all confirmed) — the actual defect is a discovery gap (payment-router: zero SKILL-DIRECTORY.md/routing-table.md entries) to fix by adding entries, not retiring. token-audit, agentic-jujutsu and ruvnet-brain are healthy and accurately grounded (verified live against binaries and the ruvnet-brain corpus itself); ruvector-catalog only needs its freshness date resynced with its own actively-updated benchmark file, plus a related_skills link from ruvnet-brain. provenance-tracking needs frontmatter modernisation and a when-not-to-use line against web-researcher's overlapping citation tools. None of the 15 skills in this batch state they are Claude-Code-only, though most assume Claude-specific `mcp__claude-flow__*` tool-call syntax or the `claude mcp add`/`--claude` CLI flags that GPT-6 Astra via Codex cannot use directly.
